title: 🇧🇪 Belgium
description: Curated lists of the best beer bars, waffles, frites, chocolate shops, street art, fashion, hiking and more across Belgium — researched from thousands of real Reddit reviews.

places.name: 10 Best Beer Bars in Brussels
places.description: The best beer bars in Brussels — lambic cellars, gueuze specialists, and iconic spots like Delirium Café. Curated from Reddit reviews.

places.name: 10 Best Waffles in Brussels
places.description: The best waffles in Brussels — Brussels-style, Liège-style & more. Curated from hundreds of Reddit reviews.

places.name: 10 Best Chocolate Shops in Bruges
places.description: The best chocolate shops in Bruges — artisanal pralines, truffles, hot chocolate & more. Curated from Reddit reviews.

places.name: 10 Hidden Canal Walks in Bruges
places.description: Scenic canal walks beyond the tourist boats — Bonifacius Bridge at dawn, Minnewater Park, and quiet residential canals.

places.name: 10 Best Craft Beer Spots in Ghent
places.description: The best craft beer in Ghent — Gruut Brewery, Dulle Griet (leave your shoe!), and hidden beer cafés. Curated from Reddit.

places.name: 10 Best Street Art Spots in Ghent
places.description: The best street art in Ghent — murals by ROA, Graffiti Street, Buren festival works. Curated from Reddit with interactive map.

places.name: 10 Best Frites in Antwerp
places.description: The best frites in Antwerp — traditional double-fried, legendary sauce bars, and iconic frietkoten. Curated from Reddit.

places.name: 10 Best Fashion & Vintage Shopping
places.description: Antwerp Six designers, Kloosterstraat vintage, MoMu museum & concept stores. Belgium's fashion capital.

places.name: 8 Best Liège Waffles in Liège
places.description: The OG city for caramelized pearl sugar waffles — certified authentic producers and iconic street vendors.

places.name: 10 Best Things to Do in Mechelen
places.description: Belgium's most underrated art city — 20 min from Brussels, zero tourists. Tower climb, brewery tours & more.

places.name: 10 Best Hiking Trails in the Ardennes
places.description: The best hiking in Wallonia — Ninglinspo waterfalls, Hautes Fagnes, Signal de Botrange & Semois Valley trails.
